parsed.summary: The patch resolves the issue with proxy models and select_related/only methods, but it may introduce unexpected behavior in other scenarios.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior of how related models are accessed, which could potentially break existing code that relies on the current implementation.
The code change could be made more readable by adding a comment explaining why the concrete model is used.
